context.content: France’s anthem is probably among the most controversial as the lyrics translate to : « Arise children of the fatherland, the day of glory has arrived. Against tyranny, bloody flag is raised. Do you hear in the countryside the roar of those savage soldiers? They come right into our arms to cut the throats of our sons, our comrades. To arms, citizens! Form your battalions! Let’s march, let’s march, may an impure blood water our fields. » What about yours, what’s its message overall and its History if you’re aware of it?
